title: Universal Media Decomposer plan decomposition
body: Created six sequential implementation plans A-F because the approved DD/final estimate classify the work as EPIC and a single plan would exceed manager/worker validation scope. A establishes the shared reducer, semantic ledger, OCFL, migrations, locators, and provenance; B adds Hatchet-only durable jobs plus text/image; C adds sandbox/providers plus audio/video/independent subtitles; D adds reversible resolution/alignment, replay projections, search/query/API; E adds operations/deployment/docs/extension gates; F owns full matrix and correction→invalidation→selective-rerun cross-tier E2E. Created shared README and CONTRACTS.md because no prior plan/contract artifacts existed. Support-Librarian confirmed DD_REQUIRED IMMUTABLE, T1-T8 complete, AMEND_AND_PASS approval, no ADR/ASR infrastructure, and open gates must remain explicit. Plan parser validation passed for every phase of all six plans.

title: Amended Plan D for Round 2 QA remediation
body: Appended additive Phase 4 to TASK-universal-media-decomposer-D-resolution-query-api. Phase 4 has 10 flat steps covering indexed continuity/temporal/spatial filtering with explicit 422 for unmappable scope, REST Resolver wiring and merge/split contract tests, segment-scoped evidence retrieval and test, plus final focused/full verification. Existing Phases 1-3 and all completed annotations were preserved; no contracts or README changes were needed because this is an additive remediation phase within Plan D.

title: Plan E amendment resolves deployment env drift and QA planning gap
body: Amend Plan E with a narrow Phase 4 remediation rather than duplicating completed phases. Canonical nested settings names are UMD_POSTGRES__DSN, UMD_OCFL__ROOT, and UMD_PROJECTION__VECTOR_HNSW_MIN_VERSION because SettingsConfigDict uses env_nested_delimiter='__'; plan must update all deployment-facing examples/entrypoint/migration seams or intentionally tested aliases without weakening nested config. Add direct app_factory/build_source_store and deterministic /v1/ready rebuild-in-progress 503 coverage, correct provider labels, test-count/failure disclosures, and 23-table documentation. Preserve all existing completed steps and no Plan F work.

title: Plan E amendment for QA R2 deployment gap
body: Amended TASK-universal-media-decomposer-E-operations-docs-deployment with a narrow Phase 4 while preserving all prior completed phases/annotations. Chosen approach is canonical nested env rename (no compatibility alias): UMD_POSTGRES__DSN, UMD_OCFL__ROOT, UMD_PROJECTION__VECTOR_HNSW_MIN_VERSION. Added explicit affected deployment/migration/startup/fixture/test/docs surfaces, direct build_source_store/app_factory wiring coverage, deterministic /v1/ready rebuild-in-progress 503 criteria, honest docs/provider/table/count disclosures, and Plan F exclusion. plan_read passed for phases 1-4.
